claim.text: A bounded 25-lead screen can produce a reproducible status census and partial L17 counter reduction; it certifies no new cryptid.
claim.scope: 25 fixed Appendix C starts; 5,000,000 raw transitions each; one candidate's synthetic probes at most 200,000 transitions per probe.
assumptions: Public status snapshots are reports, not independently rebuilt solution certificates.
The universal L17 sweep derivation is supplied mathematically but is not Lean formalized.
The original local protocol is not externally authenticated, and its original input-checksum field is not reproducible from delivered inputs.
forbidden_promotions: No new cryptid, complete universal reduction, infinite non-halting proof or discovery-rate benefit.
Same unrooted transition table does not imply the same blank-start halting question.
Derived huge raw times are not simulated or Lean-verified prefixes.

specification.intended_object: Exact sparse-tape semantics of the 25 literal Turing machines, state/reflection table conjugacies, lossless repeated-block encodings and guarded L17 counter endpoints.
invariants: Blank symbol 0 and the complete finite nonzero tape are preserved by representation.
A rooted conjugacy preserves initial state A; unrooted witnesses record its image.
Both parser variants use exactly the same saved configurations.
Unsupported rules and fixed-budget timeouts remain explicit.
known_answer_cases: Undefined transition at the start has zero successful transitions.
A known-family L09 table witness sends A to D and does not preserve the blank start.
L17 reaches C(0,2) after two raw transitions.

implementation.artifact: scan.cpp; tm.py; analyze.py; census.py; probe_l17.py; test_pipeline.py
implementation.commit: Additive analysis/appendix-c-leads directory; no Git commit or repository mutation. Upstream module inventory pinned to a0c1f56af53a76e985a656032b48015f7e48921b.
implementation.environment: Python 3.12.14; GCC 13.3.0; C++17; standard library only; no Lean/lake.
implementation.representation: C++ dense bounded tape with exact reservoir snapshots; independent Python sparse dictionary tape; integer counter formulas and complete-tape endpoint checks.

metric.name: Typed census, witnessed table families, bounded halts, representation diagnostics, raw endpoint agreement and new certified reductions.
metric.units: Starts, raw transitions, configurations, blocks and integer counters.
equivalence_attacks: Random state relabeling, tape reflection and all-transition witnesses.
Reject changed table transitions and unsupported start equivalence.
Independent literal Appendix D parser and full tape expansion.

black_box: 15 unittest methods pass; C++ scanner compared with a Python sparse-tape oracle on all 25 leads, 3 answer tables and 100 seeded random tables.
structural: New directory only; no Lean files or existing scripts modified.
No simulation, writes, network calls or compiler invocation occur on import of the executable entry-point modules.
Sweep traces check that no cell outside their block is read.
property_based: All 1,023 binary words of lengths 0 through 9 plus 500 seeded random/structured strings, both block widths.
4,433 distinct guarded L17 branch inputs and 80 collapsed-countdown inputs checked against raw tape endpoints.
metamorphic: Random table state renaming and reflection preserve canonical forms; every emitted witness is checked transition by transition.
Lossless expansion of both independently compressed sides preserves the head boundary.
fuzzing: One-transition table mutation, stray nonzero tape cells, zero budget, support-width exclusion, negative guards and an exact-budget halting endpoint.
historical: Appendix D's lookahead example, known Racheline2024 initial-state distinction, and the literal Appendix C lead queue.

matched_baselines: Maximum block length 8 versus 32 on identical 3,740 captured configurations.
Independent sparse interpreter versus C++ simulation; literal paper pseudocode versus optimized parser.
negative_controls: Changing one transition defeats a table-conjugacy certificate.
Known same-table family starts are rejected as rooted equivalences.
Stray tape cells outside the C(a,b) template defeat recognition.
controls.compute_parity: The same frozen 5-million-step trajectories feed both parsers. No timing or discovery-rate comparison is inferred from block count.
controls.parameter_parity: Seed, horizons, sample capacities and width filters are identical; only the maximum block length differs in that comparison.
controls.sampling_parity: Both parsers use the identical stratified reservoir. These samples are not claimed to be uniform over time or consecutive return events.
controls.data_access_parity: Identical exact saved tape strings; all public source snapshots and their hashes are bundled.

preregistration.prediction: Local prospective protocol recorded before raw scans; not authenticated preregistration. Its full queue matches inputs, but its original checksum field is not reproducible. Derived outer-countdown arithmetic was added after the screen.
preregistration.primary_metric: Additional complete universally checked reduction, with status/equivalence checks and blank-start closure.
preregistration.uncertainty_method: Exact finite comparisons on specified inputs; no asymptotic, p-value or posterior interpretation.
preregistration.kill_condition: No additional complete universally checked reduction within the budget means no measured discovery-rate benefit.
preregistration.stop_condition: One 5-million-step screen per lead; fixed 200,000-step bound per selected synthetic probe, with no failed-horizon extension. Derived arithmetic endpoints are separately labeled.
preregistration.promotion_rule: Only universal macro proof, blank-start entry, reachable closure and novelty/equivalence review permit a new certified reduction. Finite matches remain M; universal interpretation awaits formal verification.

primary_sources: Uploaded arXiv:2610.22603v2 Appendix C and D

independent_witnesses.name: Sparse-tape reference and literal paper parser
independent_witnesses.origin: Different code paths written by the same reviewing agent; not an external independent replication.

result.observed: 25 starts each survived 5 million raw transitions; 3,740 snapshots. Nineteen unrooted table families, including three starts of a documented family; L25 reported solved pending verification. Fifteen tests pass. L17 has 4,433 guarded raw endpoint checks, 80 collapsed checks, and 64 frontier probes (39 returns, 25 timeouts, no halts).
result.effect_size: Zero newly certified cryptids and zero complete additional universally checked reductions. Mean block count 12.569786 -> 11.875936 is a representation diagnostic only.
result.uncertainty: Finite simulation and sampled parameter checks. Public resolution reports not rebuilt. L17 universal sweep derivation not Lean formalized. Large-time boundary is derived conditionally, not simulated. No complete literature or behavioral-equivalence search.
retired_claims: The 25 missing exact upstream/table entries are 25 new cryptids.
Ignoring the start state deduplicates blank-tape halting questions.
A lower block count measures a discovery-rate improvement.
